document.title: Zookeep Setup and Python Package Implementation Spec
document.purpose: Define the addition of zookeep setup and the python-package field in zoo-project.json, including how init, inspect, and doctor should respond to it.
author: Lion Kimbro
ChatGPT

overview.basic: This addition extends zookeep from project identification into lightweight project scaffolding.
focus: Capture the Python package name in zoo-project.json.
Create standard directories through a setup command.
Make inspect and doctor aware of missing Python package information.
overview.constraint: Behavior should remain explicit, lightweight, and easy to repair by hand.

field.name: python-package
field.description: Describe the Python package associated with the repository when the repo-type is python-2026-03.

name.description: The package folder name that should live under src/.

usage-rule.python-2026-03: The field should exist for python-2026-03 repositories. If the package name is not yet known, doctor may infer it from an existing src package or create it with name set to null.

init-command.name: zookeep init
init-command.addition: Prompt for python-package.name in the tkinter form.

setup-command.name: zookeep setup
setup-command.purpose: Create lightweight standard project folders based on zoo-project.json.
behavior: If repo-type is python-2026-03 and python-package.name is present, create src/<python-package-name>/.
If repo-type is python-2026-03 and python-package.name is present, create src/<python-package-name>/__init__.py if missing.
If python-package.name is missing for a python-2026-03 repository, do not create the package directory and print a message asking the user to update zoo-project.json.

checks.name: python-package-required
checks.description: Whether the current repo-type requires python-package information.

checks.name: has-python-package-name
checks.description: Whether python-package.name is present and non-empty.

checks.name: python-package-name
checks.description: The current package name value, or null if absent.

doctor-command.name: zookeep doctor
doctor-command.addition: Repair missing python-package information for python-2026-03 repositories.

checks.name: python-package-name-present
checks.description: Check whether python-package.name exists for python-2026-03 repositories.

repairs.condition: repo-type is python-2026-03 and python-package.name is missing
action: Inspect src/ for package directories containing Python code.
If exactly one candidate exists, set python-package.name to that directory name.
Otherwise, ensure python-package exists and set python-package.name to null.
If the name could not be inferred unambiguously, print a message requesting that the user update the file.

example-output: python-package.name missing. Repaired from existing src/my_package package.
python-package.name missing. Added null placeholder. Please update zoo-project.json.

directory-layout.python-package: src/<python-package-name>/ for python-2026-03 repos when the name is known

repair-philosophy: Doctor should prefer an already-existing src package when the evidence is clear.
Doctor should not invent a package name when the evidence is unclear.
The user remains responsible for choosing the real package name.

non-goals: No validation of Python package naming rules in this version.
No file creation inside the package directory beyond __init__.py.
No repo-type-specific scaffolding beyond docs/raw and src/<package>.
